title: As Long as Khasi Dance Endures (Katba Dang Neh Ka Shad Khasi)
khasi_title: Katba Dang Neh Ka Shad Khasi
cultural_context: Patriotic cultural anthem proclaiming that as long as the drums roll and the maiden dance circles the ground, the Khasi identity shall never perish, from 'Ki Sur Ba Dang Sawa' (1992).
lyrics_khasi:
Katba dang neh ka Shad Khasi,
Ka jaidbynriew kan neh dor-dor;
Ki ksing ki nakra haba ki kynud,
Ka pynim biang ia ka mynsiem;
Ki kynthei ki phong la ka pansngiat ksiar,
Ki samla ki bat la ka waitlam ba shlur,
Ha madan shad ki ieng da ka burom
Ban pynsah nam ia ka ri baroh.

Wat la ki por ki kylliang ki kylla,
Ka sur ki kpa kam ju lah ban jah;
Ha man ka step, ha man ka janmiet,
Ka lyer ka pyrsad ia ka jingshisha;
To kynmaw, ko khun u Hynniewtrep,
Ia ka nongrim ba la buh u Blei,
Katba dang sawa ka tangmuri
Ka burom jong ngi kan tyngshain.
lyrics_english:
As long as Khasi traditional dance endures,
Our nation shall remain steadfast and strong;
When the sacred drums and nakras rumble,
They breathe new life into the soul;
Maidens adorn their crowns of pure gold,
Youths grasp their valiant swords of steel,
Upon the sacred dancing arena they stand with dignity
To uphold the glory of the whole motherland.

Though eras shift and worlds transform,
The voice of the forefathers can never fade;
In every dawn, in every twilight,
The mountain wind whispers the truth;
Remember, O children of the Seven Huts,
The foundation laid by God Almighty,
As long as the Tangmuri pipe resounds,
Our honor shall radiate forever.
